**Relevant information:**

- Item 1 (2023-05-26): The user says they lost their old charger at the gym "about two weeks ago", so the loss was around May 12, 2023.
- Item 2 (2023-05-26): The user says they got their new phone case "about a month ago", so it arrived around April 26, 2023.

**Reasoning:**

Both statements were made on the same day, so the time references can be compared directly. A month ago (about late April) is earlier than two weeks ago (about mid-May). The phone case therefore came first, and the charger was lost roughly two weeks later.

**Answer:** The narrator received their new phone case first (about a month ago). They lost their phone charger afterward (about two weeks ago).
